fact: RTS reports that the communications and digital minister relaunched works on the Parc des Technologies Numériques at Diamniadio, whose first phase of 12.5 hectares is to include three ICT towers for tech firms and startups, an incubation centre and a research centre, with phase one due by March 2026.
Senegal and the Gates Foundation launched the Senegal AI Scaling Hub in Dakar on 29 October 2026 to bring together researchers, startups, firms and students; no programme or cohort is stated.
News Day says the Parc technologique numérique is being finalised.
